title: Epi-Logic: A Conceptual Framework for Epistemic Runtime Control, Schema Validity Checking, and Controlled Accommodation in Autonomous AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.24755v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous AI agents are increasingly deployed in areas where wrong decisions are hard to reverse. This paper examines schema mismatch: the condition in which an agent operates within an interpretive frame that no longer applies to the current context. Outputs produced under such a mismatch can appear internally consistent, linguistically plausible, and largely factually correct; output-quality metrics alone therefore capture the underlying loss of validity only partially.   The paper introduces Epi-Logic, a conceptual framework for epistemic runtime control. It couples the detection of schema dissonance, a graduated reduction of autonomy, and the auditable switch to a validated schema. A schema is formalised as a tuple of variable space, expectation model, validity conditions, axioms, and metadata. translated_title: Epi-Logic：面向自主AI智能体的认知运行时控制、模式有效性检查与受控顺应的概念框架
translated_abstract: 自主AI智能体越来越多地被部署在错误决策难以逆转的领域。本文研究了“模式失配”（schema mismatch）问题：即智能体在一个不再适用于当前情境的解释框架内运行的状态。在这种失配状态下产生的输出可能看起来内部一致、语言上合理，且在很大程度上事实正确；因此，仅凭输出质量指标只能部分捕捉到潜在的失效问题。本文提出了Epi-Logic，一个用于认知运行时控制的概念框架。它将模式失调的检测、自主性的分级降低以及向已验证模式的可审计切换相结合。模式被形式化为一个由变量空间、期望模型、有效性条件、公理和元数据组成的元组。Epi-Score聚合了七个分级的认知失调维度；其中时间有效性维度D8用于处理有效性条件的违反……
tldr: 提出了Epi-Logic概念框架，通过检测模式失调、分级降低智能体自主性并可审计地切换至已验证模式，来解决自主AI智能体在解释框架失配时输出看似正确但实际失效的问题。
en_tdlr: Epi-Logic is a conceptual framework for epistemic runtime control in autonomous AI agents that couples schema dissonance detection, graduated autonomy reduction, and auditable switching to validated schemas to address schema mismatch, where outputs may appear correct while resting on an invalid interpretive frame.
